# hearing

> Pluggable meeting transcription & context-aware AI agents, batch or live

- [hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx](_autosummary/hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx.html.md): parakeet-mlx (NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT on Apple Silicon via MLX) backend for scribed, from hearing.
- [hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx.adapter](_autosummary/hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx.adapter.html.md): Adapter for the parakeet-mlx backend (NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT on Apple Silicon).
- [hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx.config](_autosummary/hearing.backends.parakeet_mlx.config.html.md): Configuration for the parakeet-mlx backend (NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT on Apple Silicon).
- [hearing.backends.whisperx](_autosummary/hearing.backends.whisperx.html.md): WhisperX (batched Whisper + alignment + optional diarization) backend for scribed, from hearing.
- [hearing.backends.whisperx.adapter](_autosummary/hearing.backends.whisperx.adapter.html.md): Adapter for the WhisperX backend (transcribe -&gt; align -&gt; optionally diarize).
- [hearing.backends.whisperx.config](_autosummary/hearing.backends.whisperx.config.html.md): Configuration for the WhisperX backend.
- [hearing.capture](_autosummary/hearing.capture.html.md): Audio capture and channel handling for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.cli](_autosummary/hearing.cli.html.md): Command-line interface for hearing, dispatched with &#96;cw&#96;.
- [hearing.context](_autosummary/hearing.context.html.md): Context stores and retrieval (RAG) for context-connected agents.
- [hearing.diarize](_autosummary/hearing.diarize.html.md): Diarization and speaker labelling for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.interfaces](_autosummary/hearing.interfaces.html.md): Facade Protocols for the four pipeline concerns.
- [hearing.pipeline](_autosummary/hearing.pipeline.html.md): Pipeline assembly — compose the four concerns by dependency injection.
- [hearing.storage](_autosummary/hearing.storage.html.md): Transcript persistence via key-value stores (python-storage / &#96;dol&#96;).
- [hearing.stt](_autosummary/hearing.stt.html.md): Speech-to-text for hearing — now backed by the scribed transcription façade.
- [hearing.types](_autosummary/hearing.types.html.md): Shared data model for the hearing pipeline.
- [hearing.vad](_autosummary/hearing.vad.html.md): Voice-activity detection and utterance segmentation — re-exported from scribed.
